selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 以眼花缭乱的敏捷欺骗敌人，用无影无踪的佯攻和无情连击让对手顾此失彼。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Deceives enemies with dizzying agility and theatrical flourishes, confusing foes with unseen flurries and misdirection.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冲动会强化你的精准与力量，使你的连击点获取技能与终结技造成的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Adrenaline Rush magnifies your precision and power, increasing the damage your combo point generating abilities and finishers deal by 20%.
Stamina increased by (5 * 1)%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
狂徒
手枪射击的爆击几率提高20%，并且现在会在可能的情况下触发隐秘之刃。

 敏锐
袖剑风暴的爆击几率提高10%，并且现在会在可能的情况下触发隐秘之刃。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Outlaw
Pistol Shot has 20% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.

 Subtlety
Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 隐秘之刃现在每15秒可触发一次，并有25%的几率打击两次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 惊慌使承受的伤害额外提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你施放斩击时，每消耗一个连击点数，就有12%的几率将一颗子弹藏于袖中。当你藏了6颗子弹时，你的下一次正中眉心不再消耗能量，而是消耗这些子弹，产生6个连击点数，并立即重置其冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you Dispatch you have a 12% chance per combo point spent to hide a bullet up your sleeve. When you've hidden 6 bullets, your next Between the Eyes consumes them and costs no Energy, generates 6 combo points, and immediately resets its own cooldown.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你消耗5点或以上连击点数施放斩击时，会立即用一记阴险的浪徒打击攻击你的目标，造成([160% of Attack Power])点物理伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you spend 5 or more combo points on Dispatch, immediately strike your target with an underhanded Scoundrel Strike for (160% of Attack Power) Physical damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 正中眉心有45%的几率额外获得2层伤害加成效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Between the Eyes has a 45% chance to apply 2 stacks of its bonus to your damage dealt.
